text.description_html:
Don-Jo 4 x 12 Push Plate

Custom size 4" x 12" oil rubbed bronze commercial door push plate. Primarily used in restaurants, warehouses, factories and stores. Made in the USA from .050" thick solid bronze. Packaged with mounting hardware for easy installation.

Specifications of the Don-Jo 4 x 12 Push Plate:

  • Plate Height: 12"
  • Plate Width: 4"
  • Plate Thickness: .050" (1.2 mm)
  • Material: Solid Bronze
  • Packaged with Mounting Screws.
  • Finish: Oil Rubbed Bronze

*Sold Individually
